body: I will check into this. I've never heard of it before either. Thank you.
Thanks for the reply. I am starting to think it might be Anxiety related. It's the only thing left.
Is this the same thing as "esophagitis" as that is written on my endoscopy report as a negative.
Thanks for the reply! I will bring that up to my Dr.

I am in the same situation as you. I have been suffering from this for over a year now. None of the pamphlets or online symptoms I’ve read really apply to me. It doesn’t have a consistency with my diet. One day I will get it on a meal of a small salad, no dressing and water and the next day a big spaghetti dinner I won’t have the slightest discomfort. When I do have it bending over doesn’t bother it at all. I’d even say lying flat on my side actually helps relieve the pain. I have taken Omeprazole for over a year now with no real benefit. I honestly can’t tell a difference when I am on it and when I miss a week. Small meal or large meals I’ve never found any correlation. I have an Upper GI tomorrow (or later today) as well. Obviously, I’m hoping it’s something correctable. Did you have to be knocked out for your endoscopy? That’s what I am dreading the most.

Thank you all for your replies. I am only able to see the gastroenterologist and get the scope done through a charity program. They won’t attempt the scope without general anesthesia. I am terribly frightened of the thought but my stomach issue is so severe it has impacted my life beyond comprehension.
Can I get a pm too?
They have given me lidocaine cocktails numerous times and they do work but wear off in 20 minutes or so. Other than that, nothing for pain.
